title: Microstructure optimization of cold sprayed Ti-6Al-4V using post-process heat treatment for improved mechanical properties
InformationInFigures: Yes. Porosity of most samples not in text, only in Fig. 6., Hardness values in Fig. 10. Stress strain curves: fig.11. Yield strength, UTS, and elogation given in Fig. 12. Grain size could be found in Fig. 13.

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: MetcoAdd Ti-6Al-4V ELI-A from Oerlikon, Kelsterbach, Germany

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: Heated at 4°C/min for 2h at 575°C in a vacuum <10^-5 Pa Pyrox furnace, then air cooled
experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Samples for porosity and microstructure characterization were machined using electric discharge machining and subsequently ground using SiC paper up to 4000 grade. Rough polishing was then carried out using a 9 µm diamond suspension, and followed by a final step involving a mixture of 90% colloidal solution containing 0.04 µm silica particles and 10% hydrogen peroxide. Tensile specimens were dog-bone shapes machined parallel to the substrate using electric discharge machining and were ground using SiC paper up to 4000 grade on both faces before testing. A metallographic preparation procedure was carried out on each sample before the hardness tests.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: the microstructure of the feedstock powder was mostly retained. interfacial regions between neighboring splats display small equiaxed α grains with β particles located at triple junctions. In contrast, no significant microstructure evolution was noticed in the center of the splats. microstructure remained heterogeneous. Early recrystallization occurred at the interface between splats at lower temperatures. Increasing the annealing temperature leads to α grains coarser than average in these locations. the area fraction of pores increased with increasing annealing temperature and there was spheroidization of pores and improved cohesion between splats.

Experiments.Notes: CS_575_AC. There were also two forged Ti-6Al-4V samples, with a similar composition to the feedstock powder, used as a comparison and made with conventional processing routes.
